title: The Beaver's Problem - 2
statementMd:
Offering the ABBYY Cup participants a problem written by the Smart Beaver is becoming a tradition. He proposed the following problem.

You are given a monochrome image, that is, an image that is composed of two colors (black and white). The image is given in raster form, that is, as a matrix of pixels' colors, and the matrix's size coincides with the size of the image.

The white color on the given image corresponds to the background. Also, the image contains several black geometric shapes. It is known that the image can contain only two types of shapes: squares and circles. Your task is to count the number of circles and the number of squares which the given image contains.

The squares on the image can be rotated arbitrarily. In addition, the image can possibly contain some noise arranged as follows: each pixel of the original image can change its color to the opposite with the probability of $20$%.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8597d71efd29bc3df2e02109d098b32443ed9a44.png)  An example of an image that has no noise and the sides of the squares are parallel to the coordinate axes (two circles and three squares).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e667bb47b6026396e990984ae3f9ca576de31ac1.png)  An example of an image that has no noise and the squares are rotated arbitrarily (two circles and three squares).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f569ddfb30c12dadfdb50afca6bcf52eb5d4aab9.png)  An example of an image that has noise and the squares are rotated arbitrarily (one circle and three squares).

## Input

The first input line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1000 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$), which is the length and the width of the original image.

Next $*n*$ lines describe the matrix of colors of the image pixels. The $*i*$-th line contains exactly $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*ij*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*ij*} ≤ 1$), separated by spaces. Value of $*a*_{*ij*} = 0$ corresponds to a white pixel and $*a*_{*ij*} = 1$ corresponds to a black one.

It is guaranteed that the lengths of the sides of the squares and the diameters of the circles in the image are at least 15 pixels, and the distance between any two figures is at least 10 pixels. It is also guaranteed that a human can easily calculate the number of circles and squares in the original image. The total number of figures in the image doesn't exceed 50.

The input limitations for getting 20 points are:

- These test cases have no noise and the sides of the squares are parallel to the coordinate axes.

The input limitations for getting 50 points are:

- These test cases have no noise, but the squares are rotated arbitrarily.

The input limitations for getting 100 points are:

- These test cases have noise and the squares are rotated arbitrarily.

## Output

Print exactly two integers, separated by a single space — the number of circles and the number of squares in the given image, correspondingly.

## Note

You are given a sample of original data for each difficulty level. The samples are available at `http://codeforces.com/static/materials/contests/178/e-samples.zip` .
statementZhMd:
把由聪明的海狸编写的题目提供给 ABBYY Cup 的参赛者，已经成为一种传统。他提出了下面这个问题。

给定一张黑白图像，也就是说，这是一张由两种颜色（黑色和白色）组成的图像。图像以光栅形式给出，即给出一个表示像素颜色的矩阵，且矩阵的大小与图像大小相同。

给定图像中的白色表示背景。此外，图像中包含若干个黑色几何图形。已知图像中只可能包含两种类型的图形：正方形和圆形。你的任务是统计给定图像中包含的圆形数量和正方形数量。

图像中的正方形可以任意旋转。此外，图像中可能包含如下形式的噪声：原图中的每个像素都有 $20$% 的概率变为相反的颜色。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8597d71efd29bc3df2e02109d098b32443ed9a44.png)  一张没有噪声且正方形边平行于坐标轴的图像示例（两个圆形和三个正方形）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e667bb47b6026396e990984ae3f9ca576de31ac1.png)  一张没有噪声且正方形任意旋转的图像示例（两个圆形和三个正方形）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f569ddfb30c12dadfdb50afca6bcf52eb5d4aab9.png)  一张包含噪声且正方形任意旋转的图像示例（一个圆形和三个正方形）。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1000 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$），表示原图像的长度和宽度。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述图像像素的颜色矩阵。第 $*i*$ 行包含恰好 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*ij*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*ij*} ≤ 1$），整数之间用空格分隔。$*a*_{*ij*} = 0$ 表示该像素为白色，$*a*_{*ij*} = 1$ 表示该像素为黑色。

保证图像中正方形的边长和圆形的直径均至少为 15 个像素，且任意两个图形之间的距离至少为 10 个像素。还保证人类可以轻松计算出原图像中圆形和正方形的数量。图像中图形的总数不超过 50。

获得 20 分的测试数据满足以下限制：

- 这些测试数据没有噪声，且正方形的边平行于坐标轴。

获得 50 分的测试数据满足以下限制：

- 这些测试数据没有噪声，但正方形可以任意旋转。

获得 100 分的测试数据满足以下限制：

- 这些测试数据包含噪声，且正方形可以任意旋转。

## 输出格式

输出恰好两个整数，两个整数之间用一个空格分隔，分别表示给定图像中圆形和正方形的数量。

## 说明

对于每个难度级别，你都会得到一份原始数据样例。样例可在 `http://codeforces.com/static/materials/contests/178/e-samples.zip` 获取。
